description: Second quartz lens fitted: juice yield up to 78%, past the 75% target
body: Fitted the second quartz lens. The extractor now presses 78% of the berry into juice, past the 75% target.

description: Speedy Snail quoted $1.95 a crate in 6 weeks; still too slow for fresh moonberries
body: Speedy Snail Couriers came back at $1.95 a crate, 6 weeks door to door. Berries would still arrive as jam. Staying with Glorp for now.
